Questions × learners

Cells show points earned as a percentage of available points. U = unanswered; — = no submitted response in this view. Click a score for the saved response. Question revisions are kept separate. Small samples should be interpreted cautiously.

Question review

Accuracy counts exact correct answers, including blanks in the denominator. Wrong-choice counts show selections, so a multiple-choice response can contribute more than one. Feedback counts cover all dates and versions.

Learner summary

Improvement is the mean percentage-point change from first to latest response on repeated question revisions represented in this view. It can reflect practice exposure and different dates; it is not a controlled assessment of learning.

How the measures are calculated

Only sessions started after attempt tracking was installed are recorded. Started sessions include opening a question set, even if no answers were entered. Administrator practice is excluded. These are practice results; the platform does not yet enforce formal exam restrictions.
